description: This file defines the IncomingRequestMonitor class, which monitors active requests and manages workload analysis for long-running or blocked requests within the Orleans runtime. It handles lifecycle participation, tracks recently used activations, and periodically analyzes workload metrics.

classes.name: IncomingRequestMonitor
classes.description: Monitors active requests, tracks recently used activations, and performs workload analysis periodically within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: IncomingRequestMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with required dependencies.

methods.name: MarkRecentlyUsed
methods.description: Marks an activation as recently used to track activity.

methods.name: OnActive
methods.description: Handles activation of a member, marking it as recently used.

methods.name: OnIdle
methods.description: Handles idling of a member, removing it from recently used activations.

methods.name: OnEvicted
methods.description: Handles eviction of a member, delegating to OnIdle.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to lifecycle events for activation and deactivation.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop that periodically analyzes workload of active activations based on configured intervals.
